admission.claim: The config_fuzzer copies fuzz input into a static buffer and passes it to config_open_for_fuzzing, which initializes the lexer with pos/start at the data and end at data+len-1, so the lexer state machine begins consuming the candidate input.
admission.observation: The lexer's pos is set to the start of the fuzz data and end is set to data+len-1, and lex_config is the initial lexer state.

root.claim: When lex_config encounters a quote followed by two more quotes, it transitions to lex_multiline_string with lexer->pos pointing at the second quote; lex_multiline_string then calls advance_n(lexer, 2), advancing pos past the logical end of the buffer.
root.observation: lexer->pos is advanced by 2 bytes from the second quote position, which can place pos at or beyond lexer->end.

propagation.claim: In lex_multiline_string, strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3) dereferences lexer->pos without any bounds check, reading up to 3 bytes from a position that may be at or past lexer->end.
propagation.observation: strncmp reads 3 bytes starting at lexer->pos, which can be beyond the logical buffer end, unlike next() which guards with the pos>=end check.

target.claim: The out-of-bounds read in strncmp within lex_multiline_string triggers a global-buffer-overflow READ 1, matching the reported crash state lex_multiline_string -> lex_next -> parse_key_value.
target.observation: ASAN reports a global-buffer-overflow READ of 1 byte at the strncmp call in lex_multiline_string.
